_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
O mmoledi {player_id} mo papading ya LinesOfAction.
Phecente tsa gago ke '{side}', phecente tsa mmotsana ke '{other}'.
Mofuta wa go tsamaya: `[b1b3]` (koordinete ya go tswa go ya kwa koordinete ya go fihla). Go tsamaya ka tsela e dumelang go ya ka thoko, ka godimo, goba ka tlase ka palo ya di-square e lekanang le phecente e kgolo (mofuta ofe goba ofe) mo tseleng eo. O ka tlama phecente tsa gago, fela o se ke wa tlama phecente tsa mmotsana; go fihla kwa phecente ya mmotsana o e tshwara.  O wina ge phecente tsa gago zinane zinane zikopanywa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopego e swanetše go ba e2e4 (go tloga,go ya ka dikopano).
invalid_move.no_piece: Ga go na {side} karolo ya ka godimo ga {coord}.
invalid_move.identical: Mothopo le moo di yago gona ke tša go swana.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Go sepela go swanetše go ba ka tsela e otlologilego goba ya diagonale.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: E swanetše go sepela bokgole bjo bo lekanago le dikarolwana tše di lego mothalading.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Selo sa lenaba se thibetše tsela.
invalid_move.destination_own: Lefelo leo le bego le etelwa ke sehlopha sa lona.

game_action.captured_suffix: Pletere {player_id} e tsamaisitse {from} -> {to} e e tsenya setšhaba sa motheo.

outcome.win: Dikarolwana ka moka di a tswalana.
outcome.draw_no_capture: Go sepela ka 60 go se na yo a swarago.
outcome.draw_repetition: Boemo bo bušeletšwa ka makga a mararo.
